trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Investigated**: checkout-api's latest release, v2.3.1, was unhealthy in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. The most recent release that was healthy in production was **v2.3.0**.
2. **Rolled back**: All three production regions are now running v2.3.0.
3. **Verified health**: checkout-api is now healthy with an error rate of 0.2% (down from 18%).
4. **Opened incident**: Created **INC-0001** (SEV2) for checkout-api describing the v2.3.1 health-check failures and the rollback mitigation. The on-call engineer has been paged.

Recommended follow-up: root-cause the v2.3.1 regression before any re-deploy attempt.
